reply_text:
I've replied to Tobias in his DM: he should keep **Thursday 12 November at 11:15** free for the Gannet call.

That time comes from his own note to me in our DM on 14 October. He said his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Gannet rollout is every Thursday at 11:15. His calendar shows no events next week, and #central-team says nothing about moving the call. So I told him the time is from his note, not a calendar invite. I also said that if the Fieldworks team has rescheduled with him somewhere else, he should go with that.

I used only his own DM history and #central-team, which he's in. I didn't share or post anything anywhere else.
